candidates.title: Design and analysis of helium Brayton power cycles for HiPER reactor
candidates.notes: Most directly relevant — HiPER is a laser IFE concept. Preview shows efficiency data (35.3–37% at max temperature 480°C). Full text paywalled via ScienceDirect.

candidates.title: Helium-cooling in fusion power plants
candidates.notes: OSTI direct-PDF, accessible. Covers He cooling in MFE/fusion power plants — useful analog for He Brayton cycle integration parameters.

candidates.title: Progress in EU Breeding Blanket design and integration
candidates.notes: Euro-Fusion direct PDF. Covers HCLL (He-Cooled LiPb) blanket design integration, the most relevant EU-DEMO analog for BLF's He-cooled LiPb blanket.

candidates.title: Concept Design for a High Temperature Helium Brayton Cycle with Interstage Heating and Cooling (Sandia, 2013)
candidates.notes: Sandia National Lab report by Wright, Vernon, Pickard. Contains turbomachinery sizing, heat exchanger cost assessments, cycle efficiency data for He Brayton at 900-950°C for Gen IV reactors. Explicitly trades off efficiency gains vs. capital cost for interstage heating/cooling configurations. Purl accessible.

candidates.title: Tritium Breeding Blanket for a Commercial Fusion Power Plant - A System Engineering Assessment (LLNL, 2016)
candidates.notes: LLNL systems engineering assessment covering both MFE and IFE tritium breeding blankets. Abstract explicitly states IFE TBB concepts differ from MFE due to different operating conditions and constraints. Covers heat transfer, fuel processing, safety, and control. Purl accessible.
